pull_request.title: fix(cargo-cost-lint): apply safe defaults to budget.toml config edges (Closes #191)
pull_request.body:
Closes #191

### What this PR changes

The previous `budget.toml` parser in `cargo-cost-lint/src/main.rs` silently dropped *every* failure mode (missing file, unreadable file, empty / whitespace-only / comment-only content, invalid TOML, or missing fields) and then explicitly discarded the parsed value via `let _ = config;`. This is the "fails ungracefully" behaviour described in issue #191.

This PR makes the parser robust:

- Extracts a small, testable `load_budget_config(path: &Path) -> BudgetConfig` helper. Every failure mode now logs a clear warning on stderr and returns `BudgetConfig::default()` instead of being silently swallowed.
- Adds `#[serde(default)]` at the struct level on `BudgetConfig` and changes `lints` from `Option<HashMap>` to `HashMap`. Any missing field falls back to defaults automatically; future field additions cost zero.
- Keeps the pre-existing stub comment: turning the parsed config into `DYLINT_RUSTFLAGS` is a separate concern, intentionally out of scope here.

### Tests

Adds 7 new unit tests under the `tests` module in `cargo-cost-lint/src/main.rs` covering:
- Empty file → defaults
- Whitespace-only file → defaults
- Comment-only file (valid TOML) → defaults
- Valid config with lint overrides → parses correctly
- Config with missing `lints` field → defaults via `#[serde(default)]`
- Invalid TOML → defaults + stderr warning
- Missing file → defaults + stderr warning

All 13 unit tests in `cargo-cost-lint` pass. `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `cargo test -p cargo-cost-lint` are all green for the changes in this PR.

### Known caveat worth flagging in review

The legacy fixture `test_fixtures/smoke_test/budget.toml` still wraps its `lints` map in a `[budget]` table header. With the current schema (which has no `budget` field on `BudgetConfig`), the toml crate silently drops the contents of an unknown table, so the `lints` map parses as empty. That historical fixture being effectively a no-op is unchanged by this PR and would be a natural follow-up to either migrate the fixture or model the `[budget]` table on the struct.

### Files changed
- `cargo-cost-lint/src/main.rs` — parser refactor + tests
- `CHANGELOG.md` — entry under Unreleased > Fixed
